svg.title: Send buffer race condition in ring attention double-buffering
svg.desc: Timeline showing how send_buf[0] is reused at step 2 while step 0's NCCL send may still read from it, causing a race condition on world_size > 2 rings.
svg.text: Fix — track send_work_[2], GPU-wait before overwrite
Add: send_work_[2] per slot; before packing slot s, call send_work_[s]->streamWait(compute_stream)
